**Why:** Added this as the new top section of `notes.md` with a finalized S7 4-tranche budget plan (hard $500 caps per calendar window, tranche 4 given extra priority since fall closes have won 4 of 6 seasons) plus a new PTO-pacing rule (keep 3-4 PTO days unstaged through doy~250, since S6's PTO hit 0 by day119 and independently blocked the tranche-4 window even before budget did). This is the last S6 data pull needed — the plan is ready to port into S7 day-1 verbatim.
